name: Maximal entry in row n of A097847.
comment: It is not always the case that a(n) = A097847(n,k) for some k that is coprime to n. The first case where no such k exists is n = 42, for which 4 = a(42) = A097847(42,k) only for k = 39 and k = 40, neither of which is coprime to 42. - _Pontus von Brömssen_, May 06 2026
